title: Automated Production Acceptance
scope: Compose the existing Build 47 Grey Hair story/edit planning read authority rather than creating a competing production model
Accept only the dedicated Grey Hair CAIP project and a confirmed Build 46 synchronization group
Require exactly four distinct confirmed camera tracks and at most one confirmed dedicated audio track
Require a human-approved Build 47 story with reviewer identity and reviewed timestamp
Require a human-approved Build 47 edit timeline with reviewer identity and reviewed timestamp
Require every story beat to remain backed by current approved active evidence from the confirmed group
Require the edit timeline to cover exactly the approved story evidence set with no silent additions or omissions
Verify every clip stays within its approved evidence source bounds and on the same source asset
Verify timeline continuity and duration equivalence at millisecond tolerance
Verify confirmed camera labels and synchronization offsets are preserved in every clip
Verify supported aspect ratio and target-duration compliance
Return HOLD or ACCEPTED_FOR_CONTROLLED_PRODUCTION with explicit checks and blockers
Keep renderer, provider execution, publication, social handoff, R2 mutation, main mutation and application Production promotion closed
Add forward Current Application Quality and syntax protection for the Build 48 boundary
build47_dependency: Build 48 consumes only human-approved Build 47 story/edit planning whose evidence still resolves to the confirmed Build 46 camera group.
execution_boundary: ACCEPTED_FOR_CONTROLLED_PRODUCTION is a metadata acceptance state only. It authorizes no render, provider, publication, social, R2, main or application Production execution.
external_lanes: CAIP private-media HOLD unless fresh authenticated runtime evidence proves acceptance
next_build_rule: No Build 49 scope is currently approved. Choose the next bounded workstream only after this Build 48 authority closure independently passes the final four-proof Development cycle.
